title: "When you play me or I attack, you may pay [2] to Stun a unit" never triggers
expected: Reproduced via runtime parse: getCardRegistry().get("ven-135-166").abilities yields only [{keyword:"Hidden"},{static modify-might}] — the "When you play me or I attack, you may pay [2] to [Stun] a unit" line is dropped. Root cause: /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/trigger-patterns.ts has no pattern for the compound trigger "When you play me or I attack," (it has "When I attack," at line 44, "When I attack or defend," at line 203, "When you play me or when I hold," at line 294, and the Jayce compound at line 438, but not play-self-or-attack). parseAbilities("When you play me or I attack, [Stun] a unit.") returns {success:false,"Could not parse ability text"}, whereas "When I attack, you may pay [2] to [Stun] a unit." and "When you play me, you may pay [2] ..." each parse fine into optional triggered abilities with pay-cost condition — so only the compound trigger prefix is unsupported. The card is loaded from data/sets/ven.json (abilities:[null,null] placeholder, re-parsed at load by data/enrich-cards.ts:30 enrichCard), with no hand-authored override, so the multi-line parser silently omits the unparseable line and no play-self/attack trigger ever exists for the engine to fire.
observed: Played Kennen to base (energy 20->17): no chain item, no pendingChoice, log only 'played Kennen'. Revealed a hidden Kennen onto a battlefield: no trigger. Moved Kennen to enemy-occupied battlefield (combat showdown, combatRole=attacker): no trigger. Runtime parse of the card (getCardRegistry) yields only [Hidden keyword, static modify-might] — the triggered ability is dropped entirely.
